G5534.definition: (χράω, see LS, see word), ; it is necessary: Jas.3:10 (cf. δεῖ.).†; (AS)

G5545.definition: see Tdf., Pr., 102; Bl., § 4, 2), -τος, το ; (χρίω), ; later form of χρῖμα (Æsch., al.),; an anointing, unction (the result of the action χρίειν; ICC, in l; but cf. Westc., in l, for the view that the oil, not the act, is meant): 1Jn.2:20 Jn 2:27.†; (AS)

G5598.definition: Ω, ω, ὦ μέγα (cf. ὂ μικρόν), ; omega, ô, the twenty-fourth and last letter. As a numeral, ω᾽ = 800, ω, = 800,000. As a symbol of the last (= τὸ τέλος), τὸ Ὦ (Rec. Ω, L, ὦ, T, ω), the Omega: Rev.1:8 21:6 22:13 (cf. Ἄλφα).†; (AS)

G5513.definition: (χλίω, to become warm), ; warm, tepid; metaphorically, of persons, luke-warm: Rev.3:16.†; (AS)

G5518.definition: a chænix, a dry measure of rather less than a quart: Rev.6:6 (EV, measure).†; (AS)

G5558.definition: (χρυσός)  ; to gild, cover with gold: pass., with dative, χρυσίῳ (pleonast., cf. Exo.26:37), Rev.17:4 18:16.†; (AS)

G5555.definition: χρυσό-λιθος, -ου, ὁ; a chrysolite (on its identification, see Swete, Ap., 288 f.; DB, iv, 620): Rev.21:20.†; (AS)

G5556.definition: χρυσό-πρασος, -ου, ὁ ; a chrysoprase (see Swete, Ap., 289): Rev.21:20.†; (AS)
